question: Which of the following developed India’s first gender-neutral Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine GARDASIL-9, in September 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MSD Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On **September 29, 2021**, **MSD Pharmaceuticals** announced the introduction of **GARDASIL 9**, the **nation's first gender-neutral HPV vaccine**.
 
• The** nine-valent Human Papillomavirus **(Types 6, 11, 16, 18, 31, 33, 45, 52, and 58) vaccination will assist in lowering the incidence of illnesses and malignancies among **girls and women (ages 9–26)** and **boys (ages 9–15)** that are caused by the **HPV types** included in the vaccine.
 
• According to current statistics, **60,078 women** lose their fight with **cervical cancer each year**, while** 96,922 **women receive a** diagnosis**.
 
• In India, among women aged **15 to 44**, cervical cancer is the **second most common type of cancer.**
